photos.desc: Tropical and subtropical moist forests (TSMF), also known as tropical moist forest, is a subtropical and tropical forest habitat type defined by the World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF).
Shorea robusta, also known as sal or shala tree, is a species of tree belonging to the Dipterocarpaceae family. Sal is one of the most important sources of hardwood timber in India.
